_doc: M1 — the lodgment fight: clear OBJ KEATON (the strongpoint town), defeat the counterattack. Trigger effects execute in declaration order (determinism law). Force re-scoped 2026-07-25: 2-8 CAV organic slice, nothing borrowed — scouts screen, two Bradley platoons clear, the mortars support the hold; fielding OPEN from H-hour. Town garrison is second-line troops with Javelins stripped (AT4s only, tuned after the Phase 3 playtest). The wider theater is NOT empty: garrisons sit on the infrastructure, known to intel only as UNKNOWN contacts.
name: LODGMENT
brief: TASK FORCE, THIS IS HIGHER. You have a foothold ashore. Push inland and seize the crossroads town to your front, designated OBJECTIVE KEATON — it owns the road net. Intel has marked UNKNOWN enemy contacts in the town, but they are CONCEALED in the buildings: you will not see them until your scouts find them or they open fire. Scouts screen forward — they are set to break contact if engaged. Expect a counterattack once you take the town. Your lead elements are 2-8 CAV: scouts, two Bradley platoons and the mortars. The rest of the task force is yours to call up from garrison as you see fit — no fires support yet. Follow-on taskings will come by FRAGO. FIND THEM. CLEAR OBJ KEATON. HOLD IT.

radio.text: COUNTERATTACK INBOUND — HOSTILE ARMOR MOVING ON THE TOWN
